Hand to hand? Luffy by a landslide, for two reasons. One, is their abilities. Despite Richard's physical abilities he sees himself as a thinker and an inventor, not a brawler (despite the fact that he instinctively falls back on his physical strengths in any fight.) As such, he has never really investigated or attempted to stretch the limits of his gifts, unlike Luffy who is constantly reaching to be better, more powerful. Consequently, Luffy has developed gear three while Richard's still just stretches and often will reach for a gun of one type or another. The second reason is will power. Once again Richard's is lacking, it's not the size of the dog in the fight, it's the size of fight in the dog. Luffy is all in, one hundred miles an hour, never give up while Richard's is plagued by all the insecurites and doubts of an intelligent man; he who hesitates is lost. That being said, if it was no holds barred and Richard's had ten minutes to plan, Luffy wouldn't have a chance.
